Overview National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR) staff provided Technical Assistance (TA) to Moore Street Seniors, Inc., in Fairbanks, Alaska, under the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Energy to Communities (E2C) Expert Match Program. NLR provided, within the TA scope of work, a building survey of the Moore Street Senior Apartments. This consisted of an air leakage test, building survey/walkthrough, and the creation of an Energy Star Portfolio Manager (ESPM) profile for the building.
